---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new provider, a UI improvement, or a backend capability.
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What do you want?

A clear, one-sentence description.

## Why is it useful?

Who benefits and how. For new providers: which site, and what types of
content (films, series, anime) does it serve.

## Proposed approach (optional)

If you have an idea of how to implement it. For new providers, paste a
relevant snippet from the upstream `cloudstream-extensions-uk` plugin if
you can — selectors, request shape, and stream resolution logic.
